audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Heimerdinger/Skill/Sion/Sion/Heimerdinger/Sion/Sion. The packet and the mirror audit (heimerdinger__sion) both give Sion/Skill/Skill/Heimerdinger/Sion/Heimerdinger/Skill, and the page's own whys argue the packet version row for row.
audit.why: whys[0] says a Level 1 charged Q from brush wins the first minute outright; whys[3] calls levels 4-5 'his peak'; whys[4] is a Sion-owned Level 6; whys[5] is his first-item spike; whys[6] is a two-sided late game. Every row was shifted against its own text.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sion/Skill/Skill/Heimerdinger/Sion/Heimerdinger/Skill in both layers as one group; ratings follow (Sion/Skill 6/10, Heimerdinger 3/10, matching the file's existing vocabulary).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why describe Sion-owned windows on rows that now belong to Heimerdinger or are even — phases[5] says 'Heartsteel is your spike, force fights the moment it completes' where the content layer says his first AP item makes the turrets shred your shield.
audit.why: The first-item swing in this lane is his, not yours: turret damage scales with his AP while your shield does not keep pace.
audit.corrected: Four phase whys rewritten to argue their own side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Heimerdinger's abilities are named properly. The full layer calls his E 'CH-2 Grenade' (it is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade), the turret is never named at all, W is only ever 'W rocket poke', and Hextech Affinity is absent from the entire matchup.
audit.why: Hextech Affinity is the interaction the page most needs and does not have: he gains move speed near his own turrets and allied towers, so chasing him into the nest is chasing a faster champion. CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — a rare case where one number covers the whole lane. Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units, further than anything Sion has.
audit.corrected: Turret and grenade named with the 11s in whys[2]; Micro-Rockets' 1325 range in wants.foe[2] and spikes[2]; Hextech Affinity written into wants.foe[0].

notes: Left untouched and recorded as unverified: three fields (whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid) assert that Unstoppable Onslaught is 'literally unstoppable' and that CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade cannot interrupt the charge. Riot's text for Sion's R does not say the charge is uninterruptible and the kit carries no unstoppable or channel flag, so this is not answerable from the data. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion from the other side and deliberately wrote 'sidestep the line' instead of claiming the interaction. This matters more here than anywhere else in the slice — it is the stated reason Level 6 belongs to Sion, and three fields plus a chart row rest on it. It needs one verified check.
